column1: compassionate|/kəmˈpæʃənət/|心智品质|adj. 有同情心的|A compassionate neighbour brought soup to the family during the cold spell.|有同情心的邻居在寒潮期间给这家人送了汤。
considerate|/kənˈsɪdərət/|心智品质|adj. 体贴的|A considerate classmate saved a seat for the late student in the hall.|体贴的同学在大厅里为迟到的学生留了座位。
genuine|/ˈdʒenjuɪn/|心智品质|adj. 真诚的|A genuine smile from a stranger can brighten a dull rainy morning.|陌生人真诚的微笑能让阴雨的早晨明亮起来。
decent|/ˈdiːsnt/|心智品质|adj. 正派的|He is a decent boy who always returns the book he borrowed on time.|他是个正派的男孩，借的书总是按时归还。
gallant|/ˈɡælənt/|心智品质|adj. 英勇的|The gallant soldier helped the wounded cross the broken bridge at night.|英勇的士兵帮助伤员在夜间走过断裂的桥。
genial|/ˈdʒiːniəl/|心智品质|adj. 和蔼的|Our genial landlord seldom complains about the noisy children upstairs.|和蔼的房东很少抱怨楼上吵闹的孩子。
jovial|/ˈdʒəʊviəl/|心智品质|adj. 快活的|The jovial old man told jokes that made the whole market laugh.|快活的老头讲笑话，让整个市场都笑了。
staid|/steɪd/|心智品质|adj. 稳重的|The staid librarian preferred silence to the chatter of the busy hall.|稳重的图书管理员喜欢安静，胜过喧闹大厅的闲聊。
frugal|/ˈfruːɡl/|心智品质|adj. 节俭的|A frugal shopper compares prices before buying anything expensive at all.|节俭的购物者买贵东西前总会比较价格。
merciful|/ˈmɜːsɪfl/|心智品质|adj. 仁慈的|The merciful judge reduced the fine for the poor hungry thief.|仁慈的法官为贫穷饥饿的小偷减轻了罚款。
benign|/bɪˈnaɪn/|心智品质|adj. 善良的|Her benign smile told the scared child that everything would be fine.|她善良的微笑告诉害怕的孩子一切都会好。
humane|/hjuːˈmeɪn/|心智品质|adj. 人道的|The humane officer treated the lost travellers with warmth and respect.|人道的警官以温暖和尊重对待迷路的旅人。
civil|/ˈsɪvl/|心智品质|adj. 有礼貌的|Even when angry, she remained civil and never raised her tired voice.|即使生气，她依然有礼貌，从不大声嚷嚷。
obliging|/əˈblaɪdʒɪŋ/|心智品质|adj. 乐于助人的|The obliging waiter carried our heavy bags to the waiting car outside.|乐于助人的服务生把我们沉重的包搬到了外面的车旁。
placid|/ˈplæsɪd/|心智品质|adj. 平和的|The placid lake reflected the mountains like a quiet painted mirror.|平和的湖面如安静的画镜映出群山。
serene|/səˈriːn/|心智品质|adj. 安详的|She stayed serene while the storm rattled the windows of the small bus.|当风暴摇晃小巴窗户时，她依然安详。
mellow|/ˈmeləʊ/|心智品质|adj. 温和的|His mellow voice calmed the arguing students in the crowded room.|他温和的声音让争吵的学生在拥挤的屋里平静下来。
buoyant|/ˈbɔɪənt/|心智品质|adj. 乐观向上的|The buoyant child believed the rain would bring a double rainbow soon.|乐观的孩子相信雨会带来双彩虹。
sprightly|/ˈspraɪtli/|心智品质|adj. 精力充沛的|The sprightly grandmother danced at the wedding until the late music stopped.|精力充沛的祖母在婚礼上跳舞直到音乐停歇。
blithe|/blaɪð/|心智品质|adj. 无忧无虑的|The blithe song of the boy echoed through the empty sunlit corridor.|男孩无忧无虑的歌声在空荡洒满阳光的走廊回响。
winsome|/ˈwɪnsəm/|心智品质|adj. 讨人喜欢的|Her winsome manner made the shy new student feel welcome at once.|她讨人喜欢的举止让害羞的新生立刻感到受欢迎。
inquisitive|/ɪnˈkwɪzətɪv/|心智品质|adj. 好学的|The inquisitive pupil asked why the sky changes colour after the sun sets.|好学的的小学生问为什么日落后天空会变颜色。
introspective|/ˌɪntrəˈspektɪv/|心智品质|adj. 内省的|The introspective writer filled pages with thoughts about his quiet childhood.|内省的作家写满了对安静童年的思考。
meditative|/ˈmedɪtətɪv/|心智品质|adj. 沉思的|He took a meditative walk by the river to clear his busy restless mind.|他在河边沉思散步，清理繁忙不安的思绪。
stoic|/ˈstəʊɪk/|心智品质|adj. 坚忍的|The stoic climber did not complain when the wind turned the path to ice.|坚忍的登山者当风把路变成冰时并未抱怨。
unflappable|/ʌnˈflæpəbl/|心智品质|adj. 冷静镇定的|The unflappable teacher fixed the spilled ink without alarming the class.|冷静镇定的老师清理打翻的墨水，没有惊动全班。
evenhanded|/ˈiːvnˈhændɪd/|心智品质|adj. 公正的|An evenhanded referee gives both teams the same fair chance to win.|公正的裁判给两队同样公平的获胜机会。
fairminded|/ˈfeəˈmaɪndɪd/|心智品质|adj. 公正的|The fairminded judge listened to both sides before making the final call.|公正的法官在作最终裁定前听取了双方意见。
openminded|/ˈəʊpənˈmaɪndɪd/|心智品质|adj. 思想开明的|An openminded reader enjoys stories from cultures far away from home.|思想开明的读者喜欢远方文化的故事。
broadminded|/ˈbrɔːdˈmaɪndɪd/|心智品质|adj. 心胸开阔的|A broadminded teacher welcomes questions that challenge the usual old answer.|心胸开阔的老师欢迎挑战常规答案的问题。
strongwilled|/ˈstrɒŋˈwɪld/|心智品质|adj. 意志坚强的|The strongwilled girl practised the violin until her fingers no longer ached.|意志坚强的女孩练习小提琴直到手指不再疼痛。
warmhearted|/ˈwɔːmˈhɑːtɪd/|心智品质|adj. 热心的|The warmhearted nurse wrote letters for patients who could not see well.|热心的护士为看不清的病人代写信件。
levelheaded|/ˈlevlˈhedɪd/|心智品质|adj. 头脑清醒的|A levelheaded friend helps you think when panic clouds your better judgement.|头脑清醒的朋友在你慌乱时帮你思考。
clearsighted|/ˈklɪəˈsaɪtɪd/|心智品质|adj. 明智的|The clearsighted mayor saw the flood risk long before the heavy rains came.|明智的市长在大雨前很久就看到了洪灾风险。
farsighted|/ˈfɑːˈsaɪtɪd/|心智品质|adj. 有远见的|The farsighted planner saved land for a park the town would later need.|有远见的规划者留了地给镇上后来需要的公园。
bighearted|/ˈbɪɡˈhɑːtɪd/|心智品质|adj. 宽宏大量的|The bighearted boy shared his lunch with the new student from afar.|宽宏大量的男孩和远方转来的新生分享午餐。
softhearted|/ˈsɒfˈhɑːtɪd/|心智品质|adj. 心肠软的|The softhearted vet could not turn away the stray cat at the cold door.|心肠软的兽医不忍赶走门口寒冷的流浪猫。
lighthearted|/ˈlaɪtˈhɑːtɪd/|心智品质|adj. 轻松愉快的|We sang a lighthearted song to lift the mood before the hard exam.|我们唱了首轻松愉快的歌，在难考前提振心情。
singleminded|/ˈsɪŋɡlˈmaɪndɪd/|心智品质|adj. 一心一意的|The singleminded researcher worked only on the cure for ten long years.|一心一意的研究者十年只研究这一种疗法。
wholehearted|/ˈhəʊlˈhɑːtɪd/|心智品质|adj. 全心全意的|She gave wholehearted support to the plan to clean the local river.|她全心全意支持清理本地河的计划的。
highminded|/ˈhaɪˈmaɪndɪd/|心智品质|adj. 品格高尚的|The highminded leader refused the bribe with a calm steady voice.|品格高尚的领袖用平静坚定的声音拒绝了贿赂。
goodnatured|/ˈɡʊdˈneɪtʃəd/|心智品质|adj. 性情温和的|The goodnatured dog tolerated the pulling hands of the laughing small children.|性情温和的狗容忍了欢笑小孩拉扯的手。
goodtempered|/ˈɡʊdˈtempəd/|心智品质|adj. 脾气好的|The goodtempered coach laughed off the mistake made in the final minute.|脾气好的教练对最后一分钟的失误一笑置之。
mildmannered|/ˈmaɪldˈmænəd/|心智品质|adj. 举止温和的|The mildmannered clerk never raised his voice at the rude customer.|举止温和的店员从不对粗鲁的顾客提高嗓门。
wellmannered|/ˈwelˈmænəd/|心智品质|adj. 有礼貌的|The wellmannered guest thanked the host for the simple but tasty meal.|有礼貌的客人感谢主人简单却美味的饭菜。
absentminded|/ˈæbsəntˈmaɪndɪd/|心智品质|adj. 心不在焉的|The absentminded professor locked his keys inside the empty office again.|心不在焉的教授又把钥匙锁在了空办公室里。
narrowminded|/ˈnærəʊˈmaɪndɪd/|心智品质|adj. 狭隘的|A narrowminded view ignores the good that strangers may also bring.|狭隘的看法忽视了陌生人也可能带来的善意。
conscientious|/ˌkɒnʃiˈenʃəs/|心智品质|adj. 认真的|A conscientious student checks every answer before handing in the test.|认真的学生交卷前会检查每个答案。
altruistic|/ˌæltrʊˈɪstɪk/|心智品质|adj. 利他的|The altruistic girl gave her prize money to the shelter for lost dogs.|利他的女孩把奖金捐给了流浪狗收容所。
chivalrous|/ˈʃɪvləs/|心智品质|adj. 有骑士风度的|The chivalrous boy helped the elderly woman carry the heavy shopping home.|有骑士风度的男孩帮老妇人把重物搬回家。
composed|/kəmˈpəʊzd/|心智品质|adj. 镇定的|She remained composed while the fire alarm rang through the silent school.|火警在安静的校园响起时，她依然镇定。
cordial|/ˈkɔːdiəl/|心智品质|adj. 热诚的|The cordial welcome from the host made the guests feel at home.|主人热诚的欢迎让客人感到像在家一样。
courtly|/ˈkɔːtli/|心智品质|adj. 彬彬有礼的|The courtly old gentleman bowed to the children on the village green.|彬彬有礼的老绅士在村绿地上向孩子们鞠躬。
discreet|/dɪˈskriːt/|心智品质|adj. 谨慎的|A discreet friend keeps your secrets and never repeats them to others.|谨慎的朋友会保守你的秘密，从不告诉别人。
equable|/ˈekwəbl/|心智品质|adj. 性情平和的|The equable teacher rarely lost her temper during the noisy long day.|性情平和的老师在喧闹的长日里很少发脾气。
genteel|/dʒenˈtiːl/|心智品质|adj. 文雅的|The genteel lady sipped tea and spoke of books with a quiet smile.|文雅的女士品茶，微笑着轻声谈书。
goodhearted|/ˈɡʊdˈhɑːtɪd/|心智品质|adj. 好心的|The goodhearted man returned the wallet he found on the busy street.|好心的男人归还了在繁忙街上捡到的钱包。
gracious|/ˈɡreɪʃəs/|心智品质|adj. 亲切的|The gracious winner thanked the loser for a match played fairly.|亲切的获胜者感谢对手进行了一场公平的比赛。
hardy|/ˈhɑːdi/|心智品质|adj. 坚强的|The hardy travellers walked through the snow without a single complaint.|坚强的旅人踏雪而行，没有一句怨言。
highspirited|/ˈhaɪˈspɪrɪtɪd/|心智品质|adj. 生气勃勃的|The highspirited puppies chased each other around the sunny warm yard.|生气勃勃的小狗在阳光温暖的院子里互相追逐。
honorable|/ˈɒnərəbl/|心智品质|adj. 可敬的|An honorable promise is one that you keep even when no one is watching.|可敬的承诺是即使无人看见也信守的诺言。
impartial|/ɪmˈpɑːʃl/|心智品质|adj. 公正的|An impartial judge treats the rich and the poor with the same fair rule.|公正的法官用同样公平的规则对待贫富。
incorruptible|/ˌɪnkəˈrʌptəbl/|心智品质|adj. 清廉的|The incorruptible official returned every gift sent to his small office.|清廉的官员退回了送到小办公室的每件礼物。
likable|/ˈlaɪkəbl/|心智品质|adj. 讨人喜欢的|The likable newcomer made friends on the very first day of school.|讨人喜欢的新生开学第一天就交了朋友。
aspirant|/ˈæspərənt/|目标理想|n. 追求者|The young aspirant to the team practised every morning before the sun rose.|年轻的入队追求者每天日出前都练习。
endeavour|/ɪnˈdevə(r)/|目标理想|n. 努力|Through great endeavour, the small club won the national reading prize.|通过巨大努力，小社团赢得了全国阅读奖。
exert|/ɪɡˈzɜːt/|目标理想|v. 运用|You must exert all your effort if you hope to finish the long race.|若想跑完漫长的比赛，你必须使出全部力气。
exertion|/ɪɡˈzɜːʃn/|目标理想|n. 费力|The exertion of climbing the hill left the children happily out of breath.|爬山的费力让孩子们开心地喘着气。
toil|/tɔɪl/|目标理想|n. 辛勤劳动|Years of toil in the field taught the farmer patience and quiet strength.|田间多年的辛勤劳动教会农夫耐心与沉静的力量。
labour|/ˈleɪbə(r)/|目标理想|n. 劳动|Honest labour builds a life that no short cut can ever replace.|诚实的劳动构建的人生，任何捷径都无法替代。
accomplishment|/əˈkʌmplɪʃmənt/|目标理想|n. 成就|Finishing the marathon was the greatest accomplishment of her young life.|跑完马拉松是她年轻生命中最大的成就。
attainment|/əˈteɪnmənt/|目标理想|n. 达成|The attainment of the scholarship rewarded years of steady silent study.|奖学金的达成回报了多年稳定沉静的学习。
improvement|/ɪmˈpruːvmənt/|目标理想|n. 改善|Daily reading brought a clear improvement in his spoken English at last.|每日阅读最终让他的英语口语有了明显改善。
betterment|/ˈbetəmənt/|目标理想|n. 改善|The betterment of the school garden was the class project for spring.|改善校园花园是班级春天的项目。
ascend|/əˈsend/|目标理想|v. 攀登|We ascend the stairs of knowledge one careful step at a time each day.|我们每天一步一个脚印地攀登知识之梯。
scale|/skeɪl/|目标理想|v. 攀登|They scale the high wall of difficulty with help from a patient good teacher.|他们在耐心的好老师帮助下攀越困难的高墙。
surmount|/səˈmaʊnt/|目标理想|v. 克服|You can surmount any fear if you face it with a calm open mind.|若以冷静开放的心面对，你能克服任何恐惧。
vanquish|/ˈvæŋkwɪʃ/|目标理想|v. 战胜|The team worked hard to vanquish the doubt that held them back before.|团队努力战胜了此前拖累他们的自我怀疑。
prevail|/prɪˈveɪl/|目标理想|v. 获胜|Kindness will prevail when people choose to listen before they speak.|当人们选择先听后说，善意终将获胜。
crown|/kraʊn/|目标理想|v. 使圆满|The winning goal crowned a season of tireless training for the small team.|制胜球为小队一季不懈的训练画上圆满句号。
bonus|/ˈbəʊnəs/|目标理想|n. 额外收获|The real bonus of study is a mind that stays curious every single day.|学习的真正额外收获是每天保持好奇的心。
harvest|/ˈhɑːvɪst/|目标理想|n. 收获|The harvest of your effort appears when the exam results are finally posted.|当成绩终于公布，你努力的收获便显现。
payoff|/ˈpeɪɒf/|目标理想|n. 回报|The payoff of early practice was a confident clear speech in the hall.|早起练习的回报是在大厅里自信清晰的演讲。
yield|/jiːld/|目标理想|v. 产生|Hard study will yield a deeper understanding of the world we live in.|刻苦学习将产生对我们所处世界更深的理解。
worth|/wɜːθ/|目标理想|n. 价值|The true worth of a goal is the person you become on the way.|目标的真正价值在于路途中你成为了怎样的人。
merit|/ˈmerɪt/|目标理想|n. 价值|The plan won support on its own merit, not on a famous loud name.|这个计划凭自身价值赢得支持，而非响亮的名号。
virtue|/ˈvɜːtʃuː/|目标理想|n. 美德|Patience is a virtue that helps you wait for the right open door.|耐心是一种美德，帮你等待正确的那扇门。
excellence|/ˈeksələns/|目标理想|n. 卓越|Excellence grows from small daily habits repeated without fail or excuse.|卓越源于日复一日不失毫厘的小习惯。
perfection|/pəˈfekʃn/|目标理想|n. 完美|Perfection is less important than the courage to try and then try again.|完美不如尝试再尝试的勇气重要。
mastery|/ˈmɑːstəri/|目标理想|n. 精通|Mastery of a language opens windows into a dozen different bright worlds.|精通一门语言能打开通往许多不同明亮世界的窗。
expertise|/ˌekspɜːˈtiːz/|目标理想|n. 专长|Her expertise in birds helped the class identify the rare visiting crane.|她对鸟的专长帮全班认出了稀有的来访鹤。
competence|/ˈkɒmpɪtəns/|目标理想|n. 能力|Competence comes quietly to those who practise the same hard thing often.|能力悄然来到常练同一难事的人身上。
proficiency|/prəˈfɪʃnsi/|目标理想|n. 熟练|Proficiency in maths gave her the key to a future she once only dreamed.|数学的熟练给了她通往曾只敢梦想的未来之钥。
fluency|/ˈfluːənsi/|目标理想|n. 流利|Fluency in a second language widens the circle of friends you can keep.|第二语言的流利扩大了你能结交的朋友圈。
readiness|/ˈredinəs/|目标理想|n. 准备就绪|Readiness for the trip meant packing the map the night before the dawn.|为旅行准备就绪意味着在前一夜就收好地图。
preparedness|/prɪˈpeədəns/|目标理想|n. 准备|Preparedness turned a scary test into a task the student could calmly meet.|准备让可怕的考试变成学生能冷静应对的任务。
bravery|/ˈbreɪvəri/|目标理想|n. 勇敢|Bravery is not absence of fear but action taken in spite of the fear.|勇敢不是没有恐惧，而是带着恐惧依然行动。
boldness|/ˈbəʊldnəs/|目标理想|n. 大胆|The boldness of the idea surprised the judges at the science fair.|这个想法的大胆让科学展的评委感到惊讶。
nerve|/nɜːv/|目标理想|n. 勇气|It takes nerve to stand and speak before the watching silent whole school.|在全校静默注视下起立发言需要勇气。
resolution|/ˌrezəˈluːʃn/|目标理想|n. 决心|A new year resolution to read more can change the shape of your mind.|多读书的新年决心能改变你思维的形态。
decision|/dɪˈsɪʒn/|目标理想|n. 决定|The decision to join the club led to friends she still writes to today.|加入社团的决定带来了她至今仍通信的朋友。
choice|/tʃɔɪs/|目标理想|n. 选择|The choice of a hard path often leads to the view worth the climb.|选择艰难的路常通向值得攀登的风景。
option|/ˈɒpʃn/|目标理想|n. 选择|Keep every option open until you have weighed what each one truly costs.|在权衡每个选项真正代价前，先保留所有选择。
scheme|/skiːm/|目标理想|n. 计划|A clear scheme for study helps the week run without last minute panic.|清晰的学习计划让一周不因临阵慌乱而失控。
tactic|/ˈtæktɪk/|目标理想|n. 策略|The tactic of asking questions turned a dull text into a lively talk.|提问的策略把枯燥课文变成了生动的讨论。
